Name: Kisaa's Food Safety Channel
Author: 13midnight
Description:
[size=2]Kisaa, Ferngill's local food tech has had enough with the plenty of food scares and misinformation in food trends going around the valley![/size]

Every Friday a random nugget of knowledge is shared through national TV ~ so stay tuned for some pieces of food trivia.

More may be added in the future ><

Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/745980]Caranud[/url] for the French Translation :3

Thank you [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/194001572-syuchinikurin/]Syuchinikurin[/url] for the Simplified Chinese Translation ^^

Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/180180273]Hayato2236[/url] for the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34165]Spanish Translation[/url] ><
